_comment: Canonical Godstone tier table. SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the tier invariant (check_parity Invariant E / scripts/check_tiers.py). 'shipping' marks tiers that the Android product flavours (android/app/build.gradle.kts) are permitted to declare and that may be installed by a store build. MEDIUM and LARGE are source-level research configurations only -- they are built (content/ingest/build_archive.py builds their archives, e.g. dist/archive_medium.db for the Invariant C archive probe) and modelled in the Tier.swift enum and TIERS.md, but they have no store-compatible asset delivery design and MUST NOT ship as product flavours until that lands. The four derived files (build_archive.py, build.gradle.kts, Tier.swift, docs/packaging/TIERS.md) are checked against this table by scripts/check_tiers.py.
